title: successful behavior: two concurrent controllers cannot both allocate the last slot
fixture: tests/fixtures/swarm_v2/account-capacity.json: account fixture with cap 2, seat eng-1 holding one slot, and two simultaneous launch requests from seats eng-2 and eng-3
fixture_clock: build() patches time.time to the fixture clock; AccountCapacity reads the same list

state_assertions.racing_controllers: the second controller commits first; the first controller's WATCH transaction retries, sees the account full and refuses account_full
state_assertions.threads: two threads released by one barrier: exactly one account_full, the other outcome is one of the two requesting holders
state_assertions.stored_rows: the account hash holds the occupied eng-1 slot and the one reserved winner
state_assertions.launch_caps: sessions_by_account adds fleet reservations and remote occupancies to the local process counts, so init-agent routing and the swarm capacity rows see the held slot

repeat_assertion: the racing test runs twice on independent fakeredis fixtures (first, second)

account_reservation_conflicts_total.dimension: account fixture, one refused request per run

cleanup: fakeredis per test; no live resource mutations
